title: Easel social workspace
body: Manage trends, planning, content creation, publishing and review in your own private workspace.
pendingBody: The ANS entry is prepared. Private workspaces open after authentication and isolation checks pass. This page does not start model tasks, spend compute credits or publish content.
costs: For the first release, configure models in your own workspace; your chosen provider bills usage. ANS compute credits are not connected yet. Review content and the destination account before publishing.
sessionChanged: Your ANS session changed. The previous private workspace is hidden. Refresh this page to continue.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: Set account positioning, scripts and calendar

create.title: Create
create.body: Prepare copy, images and video assets

publish.title: Prepare publication
publish.body: Check the platform format, content and account

connecting.title: Connecting your workspace
connecting.body: The first launch prepares an isolated environment. Please wait.

login_required.title: Connect your ANS sign-in
login_required.body: Complete sign-in in a new window, then reconnect.

account_mismatch.title: The accounts do not match
account_mismatch.body: The old workspace is hidden. Reconnect using your current ANS account.

unavailable.title: Workspace unavailable
unavailable.body: The service may be starting, at capacity or temporarily unavailable. Reconnect later. Check uncertain publication results before repeating an action.
